title: POST /api/auth/reset-password — apply new password
description: Implement the password reset completion: verify the reset token, update the password, invalidate the token, and return success.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 400 if token is invalid or expired
Updates password_hash for the user on success
Marks the reset token as used (cannot be reused)
Invalidates all existing refresh tokens for the user (force re-login)

steps.details: 1) Validate { token: string, newPassword: string min(8) }. 2) Find all unused, non-expired password_reset_tokens. 3) For each, compare bcrypt.compare(token, token_hash). Find the matching one. If none, return 400 'Invalid or expired token'. 4) Hash newPassword with bcrypt cost 12. 5) Update user.password_hash. 6) Mark reset token as used (set used_at = NOW()). 7) Delete all refresh_tokens for the user (force re-login everywhere). 8) Return 200 { message: 'Password updated successfully' }.

1. Forgot-password → get email with token. 2. POST /api/auth/reset-password with token + new password → 200. 3. Login with new password → 200. 4. Try same reset token again → 400. 5. Try old password → 401.

technicalNotes: Deleting all refresh tokens on password reset is a security measure: invalidates all sessions
